placeName.zh-CN: 中国香港西贡至大帽山
placeName.en: Sai Kung to Tai Mo Shan, Hong Kong

details.direction: Point-to-point from Pak Tam Chung, Sai Kung, to Rotary Club Park, Tai Mo Shan Road
details.distanceMethod: Official 2027 race card on the organiser home page: 100 km. The 2027 HK100 course page also describes a '100km journey'. UTMB Index records the 2026 edition, whose course was shortened by roughly 7 km after typhoon damage, as 92.9 km; that is a different edition and is not used here. This card uses the official 2027 figure.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2027 race card: 5,142 m of positive gain. The 2027 course page describes the same edition as climbing 'over 5,000 m'. UTMB Index records 5,073 m for the shortened 2026 course, which is a different edition and is not used here. No official page publishes a descent total. This card uses the official 2027 race card.
details.attribution: Hong Kong 100 Ultra Marathon. The official HK100-Full-2027.gpx is served from the organiser's domain; its metadata names plotaroute.com as creator and carries no licence or copyright terms, so this site links to it and does not host a copy, draw the track or redistribute the file.
